headline: Shopify Stock Up 15% This Week: What Is Driving The Move? - The Bull
summary: Shopify shares added 7.12% on Tuesday to close at $147.74. The rise followed Meta's selection of Shop Pay as the checkout layer for Muse, its new AI assistant.
why: Shopify is a Canadian e-commerce platform whose payments and checkout products generate revenue from merchant sales, so partnerships affecting checkout volume matter to investors.
